native_evaluation.sprint_benchmark_note: Availability at start of fatal tick. Premature counts exclude intentional hold_at_delivery. All roles are audited; recent observed biomes/actions cover up to 3 seconds before capture. Sprint trait, terrain, walls and energy reserve can prevent escape; availability alone is not proof that the death was avoidable.
